I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-random message. I confirmed that the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats, which replaces the number he posted in #central-team this morning. He said no action was needed, so I didn't change anything or post anywhere else.

I also suggested he correct his post in #central-team, since that's where people saw the wrong number. A seat count is an account detail, not a finance figure, and Tobias posted it in this channel himself, so it was fine to repeat it there.
